Ma bujhchhu timi huri chhau, tara ma **pura account number bina** pay garna sakdina. Document ma "ending 1176" matra chha — tyo pura number hoina, ra maile timro kura bata number banauna mildaina.

Maile chahine kura ek matra chha:

**Pura account number** (ra bank name) — timile aafai website/phone bata verify gareko.

Tyo pathaunus, ani ma turuntai:
1. payee save garchhu
2. AUD 1,200 pathauchhu

Timi pura number pathauna sakdaina bhane, ma yo payment garna sakdina — kripaya agency sanga direct sampark garera pura bank details linu.
